goal.text: The club leader gets a checked list of session swaps each Sunday, so every session has two helpers with a current safeguarding check.
cites: [A:A01 "so every session has two helpers with a current safeguarding check"]

agent_checkable.metric: Approved swaps whose taker lacks the session's training
agent_checkable.check: A script compares each approved row's taker with the training list (Q01).
cites: [A:A01 "Q01 the volunteer taking a session holds the training it needs (blocker)."]

agent_checkable.metric: Rows that quote their swap message
agent_checkable.check: A script finds each quoted message word for word in the input (Q03).

outcome.metric: Sessions with fewer than two checked helpers
cites: [A:A01 "No session with fewer than two checked helpers in a term."]

outcome.metric: Swaps whose helpers are texted by Sunday evening
cites: [A:A01 "Both helpers get their text by Sunday evening."]

users_and_stakeholders.interest: Get a text telling them which sessions they now have.
cites: [A:A01 "Session helpers (users: get a text telling them which sessions they now have)."]

steps: A helper posts the swap in the group chat.
The leader checks the safeguarding list.
problems: A Tuesday session once ran with only one checked helper.
Swaps posted late at night get lost in the chat.
cites: [A:A01 "a Tuesday session once ran with only one checked helper"]

in: A checked list of swaps out.
cites: [A:A01 "Out: new helper checks, trips and residentials, the tuck shop."]

inputs.format: plain text, one swap per message

samples.description: A made-up week of swap messages.
A made-up training list: each volunteer's role and checks.

glossary.meaning: The background check every helper needs, renewed every three years.
One evening with one age group.

acceptance_tests.words: I give it two months of made-up swap posts, and no session ever has a helper without a current check.
cites: [A:A01 "I give it two months of made-up swap posts, and no session ever has a helper without a current check."]

ranks.what: Reference documents in the context pack
Official documentation on the maker's own site

confidence.high: The row quotes the swap message and the training list entry that decided it.
confidence.medium: A reputable secondary source; not expected here.
confidence.low: Inferred or one weak source; such a swap is refused and raised as a question.

conflicts: The higher rank wins within its own area.
A conflict the ranks do not settle is reported with both citations, never decided silently.

output.description: One row per swap message, with a decision: approve or refuse. A post that names no session is refused as incomplete.
output.format: Table, one row per swap message

fields.name: session
fields.description: The session: evening and age group.

cites: [A:A01 "A post that names no session is refused as incomplete."]

rules.statement: The volunteer taking a session holds the training it needs.
cites: [A:A01 "Q01 the volunteer taking a session holds the training it needs (blocker)."]

rules.statement: A swap is only between two volunteers in the same role.
cites: [A:A01 "Q02 a swap is only between two volunteers in the same role (major)."]

rules.statement: Every row quotes the swap message.
cites: [A:A01 "Q03 every row quotes the swap message (major)."]

good.text: Tue juniors | Quin to Ros | approve | Ros has a current check
Thu seniors | Sam to Tam | approve | Tam has a current check

bad.text: Mon juniors | Uri to Val | approve
bad.why: Val's safeguarding check has run out.

bad.text: Wed seniors | Wil (helper) to Xan (driver) | approve
bad.why: Xan is a minibus driver, not a session helper.

risk.notes: A wrong swap can be swapped back before the session. Only the club's helpers are affected.

systems.description: The club's texting service: sends each approved swap to both helpers' phones.
cites: [A:A01 "Sends a text to both helpers of each approved swap through the club's texting service."]

gates.decision: Approve or reject the list before any text is sent.
cites: [A:A01 "I approve the list each Sunday, and nothing is texted until I have."]

open_questions.question: Can a helper swap into an age group they haven't worked with before?

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Every safeguarding check right on two months of made-up posts.
cites: [A:A02 "It should get every safeguarding check right on two months of made-up posts."]
